title: primula bella subsp. cyclostegia
intro: Primula bella subsp. cyclostegia, commonly known as the Himalayan primrose, is a subspecies of flowering plant that belongs to the Primulaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory conditions, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Primula bella subsp. cyclostegia include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which help to relieve coughs and ease breathing difficulties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
